text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their 
skills begins once again this year. Mejiro 
Ramonu was—

"Even in the sweltering heat, she somehow 
looked to be in high spirits. Probably 
because her excitement for the upcoming 
races kept growing and growing."
choice_data_list:
All that's left is for Rudolf to be 
confirmed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You seem rather anxious, don't you?

A thought crosses my mind. She's trying to 
bring Symboli Rudolf back to the turf for 
the sake of a future where Mejiro Ramonu 
can keep running, but...
choice_data_list:
Deep down, do you just want to run with 
the two of them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I had no intention of hiding it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To express love in the supreme race— She 
is not an appropriate element for that 
purpose."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It seems you are making an effort to look 
at things from a higher vantage point, at 
least."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You just want to see a fantastic race... 
That's all it comes down to for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
We've had enough standing around talking, 
haven't we?

—In preparation for the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup and the showdown with the Classic 
Triple Crown Umamusume, let's hone our 
legs even further at the summer training 
camp.
